messages:
kayla: Heads-up — Edgenet asked whether we can guarantee <50ms p95 for embeddings when they use BYO-CMK (CloudHSM) + per-request envelope. They also want a cost delta for the HSM path and pen-test timing. cc @riya

riya: I can pull perf notes. For Dedicated with model <=8k context and small batching we typically hit <50ms p95. BYO KMS adds network + unwrap overhead (~3–8ms) depending on RTT. Need their expected QPS and region.

dave: Quick clarifying Q: are they doing per-request envelope unwraps, or just key unwrap at model load? Per-request envelope/signing is the expensive path.

kayla: They want per-request envelope for audit: each inference should be re-wrapped for tenant auditing. Plan is CloudHSM in us-east-1, cross-account setup. They have a pen-test scheduled in ~4 weeks — wants preflight checklist.

logan: Pricing notes: HSM proxy adds infra + per-unwrap costs. For Dedicated we model a monthly proxy surcharge + per-10k unwrap meter. Need QPS to give concrete numbers. Pen-test ops are typically PS billable.

riya: @kayla ask them for: 1) expected QPS (peak/avg), 2) p99/99.9 targets, 3) traceroute to our proxy FQDN so we can estimate RTT.

kayla: Will request those. Also: rotation window question — can we do a rolling rotation with zero downtime? What's the runbook/flags?

dave: Yes — we support rolling rewrap with zero-downtime if you use caching and staggered rotate. Example snippet for runbook:

```
# rotation runbook (high level)
set rotation_mode=staggered
set cache_ttl=60s
# pre-warm: perform key unwrap on a small batch and push to KV cache
# step 1: start new key on HSM, publish to control plane
# step 2: mark new key active, services pre-warm cache
# step 3: cut traffic gradually, monitor error rate and latency
# step 4: deprecate old key after TTL expires
```

dave: Caveat: if their network RTT spikes to HSM on rewrap we may see tails; we recommend a local cache + retry/backoff config. I'll include mitigation steps.

kayla: They also asked for SOC2 artifacts and a key-handling diagram for their security questionnaire. @riya can you attach the BYOK diagram + checklist?

riya: Link (internal): https://redwood.internal/docs/security/byok-kms - will attach architecture diagram and the audit checklist to the thread.

kayla: Pen-test fees — do we include or bill separately?

logan: We bill PS for pen-tests. Estimate: 1–2 days onsite/remote at $2000/day + standby support $500/day. For HSM path: estimate a ~15% upward unit cost delta to cover proxy, signing, and extra ops on reserved clusters. I'll draft a simple cost table once we have QPS.

sec-bot: INCIDENT-HINT: previous key-unwrap latency spike in us-east-1 on 2026-02-10 (ops ticket #4567). Ops team traced to transient CloudHSM network egress. Tagged for preflight.

dave: Acknowledged. I'll include a test plan: synthetic unwraps from their VPC -> our proxy -> HSM during preflight (target Thursday). Will share raw scripts.

kayla: Sounds good. Action items: 1) I'll ask Edgenet for QPS + traceroute + pen-test scope. 2) @riya will upload SOC2/byok artifacts. 3) @logan will prepare provisional pricing delta + PS quote. 4) @dave will prepare rotation runbook + test scripts.

kayla: Anything I'm missing?
